"Comprehensive Reform of the 'Big Ideological and Political Course.' Utilize technologies such as artificial intelligence and robotics to enrich the 'Fifteen Minutes Between Classes' activity, supporting the integrated education of in-class, between-class, and after-class learning. Expand application scenarios in areas such as AI + Smart Sports, AI + Aesthetic Education, and AI + Labor Education, enhancing students' physical fitness, cultivating their aesthetic taste and cultural literacy, and deepening their understanding of the value of labor. Explore AI-driven comprehensive quality assessment for students to support their personalized and diverse development.

(14) Empowering Students' Physical and Mental Health Development. Establish a health education resource library covering all educational stages, use artificial intelligence and big data technology to create health growth profiles for students, conduct regular psychological condition monitoring and analysis, and build an AI health coach for all-day companionship. Construct a collaborative education 'Teaching Alliance' among families, schools, and communities, utilizing artificial intelligence technology to expand communication methods and channels between home and school, and explore a new type of 'Parent School' empowered by AI, providing parents with ubiquitous and precise learning and educational services to achieve synchronized resonance and support student growth.

(15) Empowering the Cultivation of Top Innovative Talents. Encourage qualified districts and schools to establish student artificial intelligence innovation laboratories, creating an intelligent support environment for outstanding innovative talents in artificial intelligence to emerge. Leverage the role of the Beijing Youth Innovation Academy and its district branches to organize summer (winter) camps focused on themes such as artificial intelligence. Encourage students to enter high-end laboratories or practice bases in universities or research institutions to participate in experimental research on next-generation artificial intelligence technologies.

VI. Constructing a Multi-Dimensional Artificial Intelligence Framework."
